_comment: Copy to %APPDATA%/Chudware/config.json and fill in. Providers: gemini, anthropic, openai, llamacpp.
_reasoning_effort_note: off | low | medium | high — applies only to reasoning-capable models (Gemini 2.5, Claude).
_max_output_tokens_note: 0 = automatic (4096 local / 8192 cloud, +4096 at high effort). Raise it (e.g. 16384) if the agent reports 'budget exhausted' / 'no JSON ops in reply' — a reasoning model spent its output budget thinking. Also settable in AI Settings.
_context_window_note: 0 = automatic (cloud large; local/unknown 8192). The model's TOTAL token window. The agent fits prompt + output inside it so a small LOCAL model never overruns its context mid-chain (which truncates the prompt and breaks the run). Set this to your local server's real window (e.g. 4096, 8192, 32768). Also settable in AI Settings.
_telemetry_consent_note: Telemetry capture consent tier: off (default — events stored locally only, never exported) | meta (event kinds + verifier scores + hashes, no geometry/prompts) | full (everything). offline_mode always hard-forces off. See contracts/telemetry.md.

experimental._note: Opt-in, default-off AI features. They run fully local and are additive — omit this block for the standard copilot. Also settable in Settings → Experimental.

vision_review._note: When enabled, a SEPARATE local OpenAI-compatible vision model judges the rendered viewport in the review/fix stages while the main provider plans + emits ops (the Seek-CAD split). The endpoint must be loopback when offline_mode is true. Serve it with llama.cpp and a vision projector (--mmproj), e.g. Qwen3-VL-4B-Instruct (Apache-2.0). The VLM proposes coarse claims; deterministic code verifies them.

experimental._cad_sequence_mode_note: Nudge the modeler to build an editable parametric feature SEQUENCE (DeepCAD / CAD-Coder-style design history) over a monolithic solid.
